name: Colorado & Southern Railway
description: Colorado & Southern Railway connected Denver with Wyoming, New Mexico and its controlled Fort Worth & Denver route to Texas. Controlled by Chicago, Burlington & Quincy from 1908, C&S remained a separate corporate railroad until its merger into Burlington Northern on December 31, 1981.
history: Colorado & Southern Railway was incorporated on December 19, 1898, and began operations on January 11, 1899, when it acquired the Union Pacific, Denver & Gulf and Denver, Leadville & Gunnison properties. The new company combined standard- and narrow-gauge routes centered on Denver.

Chicago, Burlington & Quincy acquired control of C&S in 1908, but C&S remained a separate corporate railroad. Through its control of Fort Worth & Denver, C&S provided the Burlington system's Denver–Texas connection.

The inherited narrow-gauge network was progressively abandoned. The last C&S narrow-gauge operation, the Leadville–Climax line, ended on August 25, 1943, and was converted to standard gauge. C&S had entered the diesel era in 1940 with EMD E5A 9950A and E5B 9950B for the Texas Zephyr.

C&S remained legally separate after the March 2, 1970, Burlington Northern merger. Its locomotives were progressively renumbered into the BN system during 1978–1980, and the company was finally merged into Burlington Northern on December 31, 1981.

locomotives.note: 85 owned and used · 134 leased from others · 22 additional units leased to others; Schedule 710.

notes: Capitalization is issued capital stock plus outstanding funded and equipment debt; it is not market capitalization or the federal profile's $83.6M net-investment measure.

paintSchemesIntro: C&S diesel power used standard Burlington-family passenger and freight schemes and, after 1970, Burlington Northern paint. These cards document C&S locomotives rather than duplicating generic CB&Q or BN examples.

paintSchemes.name: Passenger Silver — Black Whisker
paintSchemes.description: Former CB&Q E5 No. 9953 transferred to C&S and wore the stainless-steel Texas Zephyr passenger scheme with black whiskers.

photo.alt: Colorado and Southern EMD E5A 9953 in Passenger Silver with black whiskers
photo.caption: C&S EMD E5A #9953 in Passenger Silver — Black Whisker paint.

paintSchemes.name: Blackbird
paintSchemes.description: C&S SD9 No. 829 wore the black-and-gray Burlington Blackbird road-switcher scheme used on C&S diesel power.

photo.alt: Colorado and Southern EMD SD9 829 in Burlington Blackbird paint
photo.caption: C&S EMD SD9 #829 in Burlington Blackbird paint.

paintSchemes.name: Grayback — Freight
paintSchemes.description: C&S F3A No. 703A represents the Burlington-family Grayback freight cab-unit scheme applied to C&S F-units.

photo.alt: Colorado and Southern EMD F3A 703A in Burlington Grayback freight paint
photo.caption: C&S EMD F3A #703A in Grayback freight paint.

paintSchemes.name: Passenger Silver — Red Whisker
paintSchemes.description: C&S E5A No. 9950A Silver Racer wore the stainless-steel Texas Zephyr passenger scheme with red whiskers.
